audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 4 and 6 disagreed with the already-written ornn__yorick mirror, which sets row 4 to Ornn and row 6 to Yorick.
audit.why: Level 6 is not a Yorick shove window — Call of the Forge God travels 2500 range, slows, applies Brittle and can be recast to redirect, which is a bigger swing than a Maiden holding a wave. Conversely two-plus items is Yorick's: Ornn is a grouping tank, and the side lane he leaves is exactly where Maiden and the Walkers take towers.
audit.corrected: win[4]/phases[4].side to Ornn at 3/10 and win[6]/phases[6].side to Yorick at 7/10, proposed as one paired group. whys[4], whys[6], spikes[1].text and late rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged a probable wrong ability name: 'Q Volcanic Rumble' in spikes[0].text, repeated in wants.foe[1]. spikes[0].text also claims Bellows Breath 'makes him unstoppable'. No spike carried a cooldown (sequencingCues 0).
audit.why: Ornn's Q is Volcanic Rupture — 'Volcanic Rumble' is fabricated. Riot's Bellows Breath text is 'Ornn advances, breathing fire. Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle' — there is no unstoppable in it, and the kit file's flags do not claim one either. Real timings: Volcanic Rupture 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s at 800 range, Searing Charge 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s at 450, Bellows Breath 12s at rank 1, Call of the Forge God 140/120/100s.
audit.corrected: Both instances of Volcanic Rumble replaced with Volcanic Rupture, the unstoppable claim removed, and cooldowns written into spikes[0].text, phases[1..5].why, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was absent from every field: caging Ornn gives him a free knock-up.
audit.why: Riot's Searing Charge text: 'If Ornn collides with terrain while charging, the impact creates a shockwave around him which deals damage and knocks up enemies.' Dark Procession summons a destructible wall — terrain. So a Yorick who cages Ornn has built the wall Ornn otherwise needs Volcanic Rupture's magma pillar to produce, and hands him the knock-up for free. The correct rule is to cage his retreat well behind him, never a wall he can charge into. The mirror reached the same conclusion.
audit.corrected: Stated in phases[2].why, phases[3].why, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and dontsFull[0].d. Volcanic Rupture's own pillar named as the other source of the same knock-up.

notes: Fabricated ability name killed: 'Volcanic Rumble' -> Volcanic Rupture, in spikes[0].text and wants.foe[1]. Also removed the claim that Bellows Breath 'makes him unstoppable' — Riot's text is a fire breath applying Brittle with no unstoppable in it. Highest-value addition, matching the mirror: Searing Charge knocks up on terrain collision and Dark Procession creates terrain, so caging Ornn manufactures his knock-up for him. Kit flag misfire as elsewhere: yorick.json tags Mourning Mist (E) 'dash'; Riot's text gives Yorick no movement, so no dash asserted.
